packageRules.description: Every version lives once in the pnpm-workspace.yaml catalog and stays exact.
Workspace packages are released from this repository, never updated by Renovate.
Patch updates collect into one pull request that Renovate opens and refreshes once a day. The package groups below keep their own pull request but follow the same daily window.
Effect packages release together and must share one version, so they move in one update.
Prisma Classic packages must share one version.
Prisma Next packages must share one version.
Better Auth stays on 1.6. Platform pins it as an exact peer, so moving to 1.7 is a planned migration, not a routine update.
